artifacts.summary: Migration map for the 6 over-length EXTENSION.md files (Rule U) plus dead-file evidence and delete-vs-redefine decision for core/slidev EXTENSION.md

memory_candidates.content: check-extension-docs.sh's required-file check (`check_file "$ext_path/EXTENSION.md" "EXTENSION.md"`) is an unconditional hard fail() for every extension, independent of SCHEMA_CONFORMANCE_GATE_MODE and independent of merge_targets.claudemd.source. Two extensions (core, slidev) have EXTENSION.md files that generate_claudemd() (merge.lua lines 807-838) never reads, because core's merge_targets.claudemd.source points at merge-sources/claudemd.md and slidev has no merge_targets.claudemd key at all. Any future doc-lint change to EXTENSION.md requirements must read merge_targets.claudemd.source as the authority, not assume the filename is fixed.

docs/guides/creating-extensions.md already documents a 'Resource-Only Extensions' pattern (using slidev as its own worked example) stating resource-only extensions should have no EXTENSION.md and no claudemd merge target at all. When an extension's actual manifest/files diverge from the project's own already-written guidance, check whether the guidance already prescribes the fix before treating it as a novel design decision.

email/EXTENSION.md's Safety Invariants section cites `domain/index-architecture.md` at agent-system/extensions/email/context/project/email/domain/, but that file does not exist on disk (only archive-mode-risk.md, staleness-detection.md, wrapper-contracts.md exist there). This is a dangling cross-reference outside check-extension-docs.sh's Rule G scope (Rule G only scans .claude/context/contracts/*.md references), so it is not caught by any existing lint.
